target_customer: Season ticket holders and professional ticket brokers who resell tickets
problem: Resale is manual: spreadsheets, guessed prices and listing on one marketplace at a time.
business_model: 10% commission per ticket sold, no subscription or listing fees
product_category: AI ticket pricing and resale automation

founders.name: Truman Gelnovatch
founders.background_notes: YC page says he flipped tickets for five years.

founders.name: Ryan Clare
education: Princeton, computer science with machine learning focus (YC page)
founders.background_notes: Company description says he built pricing software.

competitors.name: Stage Front
competitors.what: Ticket broker software with inventory sync, pricing and analytics
competitors.traction_then: Described as well established in its own 2025 guide

competitors.name: Automatiq (formerly Broker Genius)
competitors.what: Analytics, distribution and managed pricing for brokers

competitors.name: Logitix
competitors.what: Automation, pricing and fulfillment for professional resellers

technical_complexity.rationale: Dynamic pricing, multi-marketplace listing sync and ticket transfer integrations are engineering heavy but standard.

defensibility.rationale: Established broker tools already exist; stickiness comes from inventory and listings living in the product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; incumbents remain separate tools.

market_need_then: Company cites a $26B resale market and manual pricing by brokers, some outsourced overseas. Traction claims are self reported: $3M inventory and 100+ sellers at launch, later $18M sold and 3,000 sellers on the site.

branding.domain_note: Company site is ticketwallet.com; an App Store listing from Ticket Wallet LLC points to ticketwallet.co

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and conversational; leans on founder authenticity (We lived in it).

branding.community_and_virality: Site claims 4.7 to 4.9 ratings on G2, Capterra, Trustpilot and App Store (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: Clear voice but a generic name shared with several ticket wallet apps.

outcome_analysis: Ticket Wallet is active with 20 people and claims fast growth in sellers and volume after launch. A founder who lived the broker workflow gives domain insight, but the space already has established pricing tools. Funding is unverified so the story remains early.
notes: A $6M seed (July 2025) led by Seven Seven Six with Palm Drive Capital, Symphony Ventures and Y Combinator appears on seedtable and signalbase snippets and a LinkedIn-sourced mention; seedtable returned 403 when fetched, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Caplight lists $500,000 total, conflicting. Competitors are 2025 sources about the category near the Spring 2025 batch.
